name: Downward-Facing Dog
description: Form an inverted V on hands and feet, reaching the hips up and back while lengthening the spine.

items.content: Start on hands and knees, hands shoulder-width apart; spread the fingers and press through the palms.
Tuck the toes and lift the knees, sending the hips up and back.
Bend the knees as needed to keep the back long; heels do not need to touch the floor.
Push the floor away, keep the neck relaxed, and avoid collapsing into the shoulders.
Breathe steadily, then lower the knees to come out.

stages.name: Hold
stages.description: Hands and feet on the floor in an inverted V, hips high, arms straight and back long. Knees slightly bent, heels raised, and head aligned between the upper arms.
